items.title: Start a blog (2 posts/month)
items.body: Short evidence-based articles per condition. Each post: author byline with Physician schema, datePublished, dateModified, 3–5 FAQs. Freshness compounds. STRONGEST CASE YET 2026-06-26 — four converging studies in five weeks: (1) Ahrefs schema-impact study (1,885 pages adding JSON-LD vs 4,000 controls, Aug 2025–Mar 2026): NO meaningful uplift in citations from AIO, AI Mode, or ChatGPT (+2.4%, +2.2%, both stat-indistinguishable from zero); (2) searchVIU real-time fetch experiment (week of 2026-06-19): all five major AI systems (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Mode) extract only VISIBLE HTML content; JSON-LD, hidden Microdata, hidden RDFa all ignored — schema is a B2A signalling layer, not a citation substitute; (3) Ahrefs 17M-citation freshness study: AI-cited content is 25.7% fresher than organic (1064 days vs 1432 days avg URL age); ChatGPT cites the newest pages most aggressively; 76.4% of ChatGPT's top-cited pages were updated within 30 days; (4) Search Engine Land 2026-06: median enterprise B2B brand cited in only 3% of AI Overviews where they rank — content depth and freshness the gap, not rank. Confirmed again 2026-06-26: osteopath-christchurch.com still owns headaches/cranial/baby/teeth-grinding/stress/arthritis queries on the strength of one short blog post per condition; MK Osteopathy still owns the TMJ slot the same way; HeadWise / healthwithin.co.nz now newly surfacing on concussion-osteopath via blog content. Per local-SEO week-of-2026-06 data, pages updated within the past two months earn 28% more AI citations than older material. With /admin CMS coverage filled (PR #91), the editorial path is shorter than ever — adding a Decap blog collection lets the clinic publish without code changes. Highest single-item leverage on the backlog by a clear margin.
